title: Tools Before Products
caption:
When I rethink a makeup routine,
the first thing I look at is the tools.

The same foundation looks different
with a brush or with your fingers.
A small change in the angle of a lash curler
changes the whole eye.

More often than not, the difference
is not in how many products you have,
but in how you use them.

Try using what you already have,
a little more carefully.
Your everyday makeup may change more than you expect.
